title: TopViewAIのCanvas/FilmStudio機能を使って、新キャラクターをデザインしながら画面内で動かすテストを行う
content:
TopViewAIのCanvas/FilmStudio機能を使って、新キャラクターをデザインしながら画面内で動かすテストを行う
整理整頓が苦手なら、Canvas機能を使って見やすい画面で制作を進める

author.name: 残念院さん 貴方のファンアートを糧にすくすく育つ怪物系教祖

en.content:
Use TopViewAI’s Canvas/FilmStudio features to test moving a new character around on screen while designing it.  
If you’re not good at staying organized, use the Canvas feature to keep your work moving forward in a clear, easy-to-view interface.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] As someone who’s not great at keeping things organized, I really appreciate the Canvas feature because it’s so easy to see and use. https://t.co/TaVJji7tRO
